message: Ah, winter storms — the perfect excuse for the family group chat to come alive! Between sharing weather updates and debating the best hot cocoa recipe, it’s nice to know we can all stay informed together. I found a great resource that covers what to do when the snow starts piling up. Remember, a warm drink and a cozy blanket always make the blizzards more bearable. How do you keep your family entertained during a storm? ☕❄️
